title: Soul Eater
description: A horror mod add creature stalking you in night.
body:
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________<details>
<summary>Spoiler!</summary>

![The Creature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/963693ae8106f326560084e73668704ec745a1ee_0.webp)

This mod introduces a highly immersive and tension-driven entity designed to add a strong horror element to the game. Powered by an advanced AI system, the entity dynamically adapts to player behavior, creating unpredictable and engaging encounters.

Behavior System (AI)
The entity operates in two primary phases:

Observation phase – it watches the player from a distance, analyzing movement and actions
Hunting phase – it actively pursues and attacks once certain conditions are met

The transition between these phases is directly influenced by the player’s behavior, making each encounter unique.

Aggression Mechanics
The mod tracks player combat activity:

Each kill increases the entity’s aggression level
As aggression rises, the entity becomes more active and closes distance faster
Eventually, it initiates a direct and dangerous attack

Nocturnal Behavior

The entity is tied to the night cycle and low-light conditions
During the day, it remains mostly inactive or hidden
This adds a layer of strategy and realism to gameplay.

Atmospheric Effects

Custom sound cues signal the entity’s presence and proximity
Visual effects such as lighting and fog indicate its current state
These elements work together to create constant psychological pressure

Requirements

Client side: Required for rendering, animations, and sound
Server side: Required for AI logic, aggression tracking, and spawning
The mod must be installed on both client and server for full functionality

</details>
